overview_description.description:
Mindee's mission is to enhance the value of your business by offering tailor-made artificial intelligence solutions for businesses.
Their team of experts in machine learning and artificial intelligence designs your solutions, from prototyping to production and training of client teams. 

As close as possible to your business needs, our end-to-end services offer guarantees a smooth and efficient integration of the highest technologies into your structure.

about_short_description.short_description: Mindee offers a tailor-made artificial intelligence solution that transforms documents into usable data.

product.name: AI Document Data Extraction API
product.description: An API that uses AI to extract structured data from various document types, enabling automation of document processing tasks.

product.name: Bank Checks OCR API
product.description: An OCR API that automates extraction of data from bank checks to streamline financial processing and reduce manual errors.

product.name: Car Insurance Onboarding Automation
product.description: An AI-driven platform that automates data extraction and verification from documents to streamline car insurance onboarding processes.

product.name: Document Workflow Automation Platform
product.description: A platform that automates document workflows by extracting data and integrating with existing systems to reduce errors and improve processing speed.

product.name: Custom Document Parsing API Builder
product.description: A tool for developers to create custom document parsing APIs tailored to specific document types and data extraction needs.

product.name: docTI (Custom Document Processing Tool)
product.description: An AI-powered tool that processes any document type in any language without requiring data model training, enabling flexible custom data extraction.
